WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: enhanced bandwidth
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: The carrier of this gene will have an innate increased bandwidth.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: greatly enhanced bandwidth
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: The carrier of this gene will have a 35% increased bandwidth. The effect is multiplicative, so it will be less significant at first, but increase as the mechanitor gets more bandwidth.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: increased command range
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: The carrier of this gene will have an innate increased command range to draft mechanoids and control them around.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: increased fix speed
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: The carrier of this gene will have an innate fix speed bonus when repairing mechanoids.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: dangerous raid presence
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are considered very powerful when it comes to raids. Raiders will consider them a huge threat when preparing to raid the colony, sending more raiders to attack.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: reduced raid presence
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are considered less powerful when it comes to raids. Raiders will not consider them a huge threat when preparing to raid the colony, sending less raiders to attack.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: rat vomit
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene will vomit clumps of mechanites that coalesce into pseudo-organic rats. This is such an incredibly cruel and disgusting thing that it's not clear if it's the result of a genetic experiment gone horribly wrong, or just a macabre prank by a truly unethical geneticist.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: pack mule
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene can carry obscene amounts of stuff before feeling encumbered.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: forsaken knowledge
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene have genetic knowledge related to Forsaken techniques and equipment. They will be able to build Forsaken structures and wear Forsaken apparel and armors.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: vicious UV sensitivity
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene have biological compounds in their skin that react viciously to UV radiation. They are so sensitive to sunlight that standing under the sun will knock them unconscious.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: high mining yield
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are adept at mining and can acquire larger amounts of minerals from stone.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: low mining yield
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are shoddy miners and can produce fewer amounts of minerals from stone.
